mapper.sql: wc.id AS workCaseId, wc.title AS title, wc.workplace_name AS workplaceName, wc.starts_at AS startsAt, wc.ends_at AS endsAt, wc.break_minutes AS breakMinutes, wc.break_paid AS breakPaid, wc.agreed_wage AS dailyWage, wc.status AS status, (SELECT ar.attempted_at FROM attendance_records ar WHERE ar.work_case_id = wc.id AND ar.attendance_type = 'CHECK_IN' AND ar.result = 'SUCCESS' LIMIT 1) AS checkedInAt, (SELECT ar.attempted_at FROM attendance_records ar WHERE ar.work_case_id = wc.id AND ar.attendance_type = 'CHECK_OUT' AND ar.result = 'SUCCESS' LIMIT 1) AS checkedOutAt, e.status AS escrowStatus, s.status AS settlementStatus, s.due_at AS settlementDueAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM work_cases wc LEFT JOIN escrows e ON e.work_case_id = wc.id LEFT JOIN settlements s ON s.work_case_id = wc.id WHERE wc.worker_id = #{workerId} AND wc.status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'READY', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'CHECK_OUT_MISSING', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW') AND ((wc.starts_at >= #{todayStart} AND wc.starts_at < #{tomorrowStart}) OR (wc.starts_at >= #{previousDayStart} AND wc.starts_at < #{todayStart} AND wc.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'CHECK_OUT_MISSING'))) ORDER BY CASE wc.status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'CHECK_OUT_MISSING' THEN 2 WHEN 'READY' THEN 3 WHEN 'ACCEPTED' THEN 4 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 5 WHEN 'NO_SHOW' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END, wc.starts_at ASC, wc.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM work_cases wc LEFT JOIN escrows e ON e.work_case_id = wc.id LEFT JOIN settlements s ON s.work_case_id = wc.id WHERE wc.worker_id = #{workerId} AND wc.status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'READY', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'CHECK_OUT_MISSING', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW') ORDER BY wc.starts_at DESC, wc.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_cases WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'READY', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'CHECK_OUT_MISSING', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW')
